name: Ignas
source:
"Since you've decided to support me, you can't back out now."

A hot-blooded and impulsive racer.
He comes across as a cool, big-brother type in front of others, but when he's with Towa, his mischievous and childish side always shines through.

Zodiac: Scorpio
Animal Aspect: Sparrow
Hobby: Food challenges
